    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_limit=20, page_index=page_index)
    if not page:

    all_friends.extend(page)

# Count friends added since October 1, 2022
from datetime import datetime

cutoff = datetime(2022, 10, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    since_str = friend.get('friends_since')
    if since_str:
        since_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(since_str)
        if since_dt >= cutoff:
